jobs.title: VP, Product & Technology
jobs.description:
Job Summary

We’re looking for a Vice President, Product & Technology to lead the strategy, development, and delivery of our platform and products across a large, multi-disciplinary organization spanning Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA, Architecture, and Delivery, while taking advantage of every opportunity created by AI.

This is a senior executive role responsible for defining where the company is going — and ensuring the organization can execute against that vision at scale. You will shape product strategy, guide long-term platform evolution, drive operational excellence, and lead the evolution toward an AI-first approach to software development.

This is an exciting opportunity to shape the next generation of a platform used by millions of people, influence company strategy, and lead a talented organization through its next stage of growth and evolution.

Job Description

Vice President, Product & Technology

At BiblioCommons, we believe great technology organizations are built at the intersection of bold product vision, exceptional execution, and deep customer understanding.

We’re looking for a Vice President, Product & Technology to lead the strategy, development, and delivery of our platform and products across a large, multi-disciplinary organization spanning Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA, Architecture, and Delivery, while taking advantage of every opportunity created by AI.

This is a senior executive role responsible for defining where the company is going — and ensuring the organization can execute against that vision at scale. You will shape product strategy, guide long-term platform evolution, drive operational excellence, and lead the evolution toward an AI-first approach to software development.

What You’ll Do

Product Vision & Strategy

Define and evolve the company’s product vision, strategy, and roadmap in alignment with company objectives and market opportunities
Deeply understand customer needs, market dynamics, competitive trends, and emerging technologies, particularly the opportunities created by AI
Translate strategic priorities into clear product direction and investment decisions
Partner closely with executive leadership on company strategy, growth initiatives, and long-range planning
Champion customer-centric thinking and measurable product outcomes across the organization

Technology Leadership & Execution

Lead end-to-end execution across the Product & Technology organization, building teams and operating models that balance innovation, velocity, quality, and discipline
Establish AI-first software development as a fundamental way of working, embedding AI throughout engineering, product development, testing, and delivery to materially improve productivity, quality, and speed
Drive predictable execution, effective planning and prioritization, and continuous improvement across the product development lifecycle
Ensure technical and architectural decisions support long-term scalability, reliability, maintainability, and business goals

Organizational Leadership

Develop and mentor senior leaders across Product and Technology
Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and experimentation with new AI-enabled ways of working
Lead the organizational and operating-model changes required to realize the potential of AI-first software development
Communicate vision, priorities, and progress clearly across the organization and serve as a key member of the executive leadership team

What We’re Looking For

Proven executive leadership experience overseeing both Product and Engineering/Technology functions
Track record of defining successful product strategy and delivering complex software products at scale
Demonstrated experience adopting and scaling AI-first software development practices, with a strong point of view on how AI is fundamentally changing how modern software organizations operate
Experience leading large, multi-functional technology organizations through significant growth, transformation, or organizational evolution
Deep understanding of modern software development, product management, platform architecture, and AI-enabled development practices
Strong strategic thinking combined with a pragmatic, execution-oriented mindset
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to balance long-term innovation with near-term delivery commitments

Nice to Have

Experience in SaaS, platform, or enterprise software environments
Experience in mission-driven, education, civic, or public-sector technology organizations

Why Join Us

This is an opportunity to shape the future of a product platform used by millions of people while building a modern, AI-first Product & Technology organization capable of delivering exceptional customer experiences at scale.

You’ll have the ability to influence company strategy, lead outstanding teams, and help define the next generation of our products, technology, and how we build software.

Regular

jobs.title: Director, Wealth Management Technology
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 258158

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

The Director, International Wealth Management is accountable for developing, leading, and overseeing delivery teams who are responsible for working with cross-functional development teams and business stakeholders to define and implement business strategies, product roadmaps, service offerings and new features.

The Director contributes to the long-term profitability of the International Wealth Management business line by establishing performance goals and work practices which drive the design and development of high-quality products and solutions.

This is a demanding hands-on and strategic role which requires the incumbent to be knowledgeable of the financial services sector and emerging trends in the Wealth and Asset Management industry.

Is this role right for you? In this role you will:

Management and oversight for delivery of a portfolio of initiatives focused on client and advisor solutions, ensuring that the deliverable align with strategic priorities.
Lead and drive a customer focused culture throughout the delivery teams to influence a client-centered design culture and to deepen relationships with business stakeholders and leverage broader bank relationships, systems, processes and knowledge.
Understand and keep up to date with emerging technologies, trends and innovative solutions across the industry.
Collaborate with business SMEs and technology teams to create platform roadmaps that align and assist in moving business strategies forward.
Provide guidance to stakeholders to ensure prioritization is driven by business value.
Define, lead and execute a cohesive strategy designed to limit technological debt and to effectively manage transition from legacy systems to modern technology platforms, maximizing operational efficiencies.
Excellent relationship building, influencing and negotiation skills to build and maintain strong supportive relationships with stakeholders across the organization.
Manage engagement with bank stakeholders and effectively communicate product release contents and expected product capabilities/customer journey.
Engage with the engineering and design teams to help determine the best technical implementation methods as well as a reasonable implementation schedule to launch products on a regular basis.
Manage communications and status reporting of ongoing initiatives, including summarizing project risks and options and facilitating prompt decisions when needed.
Maintain an understanding of financial services markets, the competitive landscape and digital transformation trends relative to the Wealth and Asset Management sector and client/user needs and requirements.
You possess a visionary and strategic leadership while inspiring team of solution architects and engineers to embrace your vision and be best in class team responsible for implementing and maintaining Wealth Technology solutions.
You are future focused with the ability to develop roadmaps and build business cases including benefits and costs
You thrive in providing strong leadership and driving employee empowerment and a high degree of engagement.
You excel in overseeing the architecture and design of solutions for the enterprise in a large and distributed environment.
You have experience delivering complex projects providing global, innovative solutions that improve the delivery of Wealth products
You excel in the assessment and selection of Global Wealth technologies and integration partners.
You excel in relationship, stakeholder management and influencing and negotiation skills, effective at all levels up to senior executives.
You can efficiently perform management tasks including incident response and escalations; vendor & contract management; infrastructure management and service resiliency; and service ownership.
You enjoy challenges of working on different types of projects (from large complex to simple).
You collaborate with various business functions to ensure Wealth Technology meets business needs.

Skills

Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We'd love to work with you if you have:

Individual projects range from Minor Enhancements ($50K+) to major strategic initiatives with $10MM+ budgets in a given year.
Demonstrated success delivering applications in an agile environment, strong organization and planning skills with a track record of successful delivery
Experience in leading and coaching delivery teams, with track record of attracting and developing talent
Critical thinking skills: using logic and reasoning to evaluate alternative solutions, recommendations, summarize conclusions and approaches to mitigate risks
Demonstrated ability to achieve strategic goals
Ability to develop strong working relationships with business and technology partners
Relevant working experience in the financial sector, Wealth and Asset Management experience
Understanding of the regulatory environment and parameters impacting the design and delivery of products and services within the Asset Management industry

What's in it for you?

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.
Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.
Upskilling through online courses, cross-functional development opportunities, and tuition assistance.
Competitive Rewards program including bonus, flexible vacation, personal, sick days and benefits will start on day one.
Dynamic Ecosystem - Free tea & coffee, universal washrooms, and lots of space for team collaboration.
Community Engagement - We offer opportunities for community engagement & belonging with our various programs such as hackathons.

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto

Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.

At Scotiabank, we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. If you require accommodation (including, but not limited to, an accessible interview site, alternate format documents, ASL Interpreter, or Assistive Technology) during the recruitment and selection process, please let our Recruitment team know. If you require technical assistance, please click here. Candidates must apply directly online to be considered for this role. We thank all applicants for their interest in a career at Scotiabank; however, only those candidates who are selected for an interview will be contacted.
